annotations.title: Rules of doing business in Poland, with sources

description: Verified facts about doing business in Poland, each with the act, article, link to the official text and the verification date. Topics: intl-tax (selling into Poland from abroad, VAT registration, reverse charge, OSS, permanent establishment, transfer pricing, Estonian CIT, IP Box), residence (permits, MOS), identity (PESEL, NIP, trusted profile, e-signature), documents (sworn translation, apostille), forms, setup (steps and deadlines), activity (PKD 2025, regulated activities), wht, treaty, tax-residence, health (NFZ, A1), property (buying property as a foreigner), contracts, labour (Labour Code rules), hiring-foreigners (work permits, declarations), deadlines, accounting (books, invoices, KSeF, whitelist), incentives (Polish Investment Zone, regional aid map, R&D relief), exit (suspension, conversion, liquidation). Pass a topic, a query, or both.

query.description: Words in English or Polish, e.g. "PESEL", "work permit", "likwidacja".
